text: Theo’s childhood fascination with the stars was deeply rooted in his connection to his late mother, an astrophysicist who nurtured his curiosity about the universe. He spent countless nights stargazing from the rooftop of his rural home, where she would often point out constellations and explain the science behind them. One of her favorite lessons involved explaining where rain comes from, using fluffy things in the sky as a relatable example for a young child. This shared interest not only bonded them but also instilled in Theo a lifelong passion for astronomy and a desire to understand the cosmos.
